physicalNotes: Radius 0.09751835 Jupiter radii from Mayo et al. 2018 (2018AJ....155..136M), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2018AJ....155..136M/abstract): 6,971.8 km at 71,492 km per Jupiter radius. GM from the mass 0.00421 Jupiter masses (the NASA Exoplanet Archive's calculated value (M-R relationship, its Chen & Kipping 2017 mass-radius relationship): a model, not a measurement, via the NASA Exoplanet Archive, https://exoplanetarchive.ipac.caltech.edu/docs/pscp_calc.html) times JPL's Jupiter GM. A sphere: no oblateness is measured.

sources.phase: Mayo et al. 2018 (2018AJ....155..136M), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname MAYO_ET_AL__2018): transit mid-time 2457228.69256 BJD, taken as BJD_TDB; with its period, the row that predicts 2026-01-01 best (1 sigma 1460 min)
